ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (dark) distribution; approximately 90% dark pixels to 10% high-intensity pixels occurring in localized scars and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Continuous dark pigmentation across both lobes. Discrete high-contrast white linear feature on the left lobe. High-contrast white clusters at the extreme distal lateral tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped notch with an estimated 150-degree interior angle and shallow bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the trailing edge; significant pixel-level raggedness and high-amplitude variations at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Linear to slightly concave trajectory sloping from distal tips toward the central median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, roughly circular high-contrast white pixel clusters located at both the left and right distal lobe tips. Scattered white micro-spots on the left lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: One prominent diagonal linear white scar on the left lobe; several shorter, faint linear disruptions on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant diagonal linear scar on left lobe; heavy colonization/scarring at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular distal tip profiles caused by dense clusters of high-contrast pixel data.
